outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo (sequence-type visualization), not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Scatter plot shows mean ± SEM as a line with individual gray dots for each biological replicate overlaid, consistent with the caption description.
Panel C consists of micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot displays mean ± SEM with individual yellow circles representing individual cells overlaid.
Scatter plot displays mean ± SEM with individual blue circles representing individual cells overlaid.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM microscopy images of localizations, not an averaged quantification plot.
Scatter plot of number of clusters/cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid.
Scatter plot of molecule percentage in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
